title: NADE: A Benchmark for Robust Adverse Drug Events Extraction in Face of Negations
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of handling negation in natural language processing for the specific task of adverse drug event extraction. While the motivation for this work is rooted in patient safety, which is an ethical concern, the paper does not contain a component that evaluates or benchmarks ethical frameworks, morals, or religious concepts. Its contribution is a new dataset and methods to improve model robustness to a linguistic phenomenon.
